answer: We formalize a mechanism where participants post dynamic opportunity-cost bonds in a garden of staked assets, governed by subgame-perfect punishment matrices. Any adversary attempting to spin a thread of malicious nodes faces capital requirements ensuring that the expected payoff of Sybil multiplication remains strictly negative. Treating each unit of value like a marble within a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function, the system enforces a strict Nash equilibrium where collusion costs exceed all possible protocol rents.
